737:t_117:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ドロシー#bigo$$ is right. I will live as my heart leads me.」

737:t_117:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Brace yourselves, $$御使い$$s! Not for the sake of $$パラダイムシティ$$'s past, but for the future we all live in, I will fight you!!」

737:t_118:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Their stench...! Compared to these guys, every villain so far was nothing. They're the absolute worst of the worst!」

737:t_118:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「As expected of a winged dog reborn! But you've got no delicacy!」

737:t_118:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「No wonder. 120 million years ago, the $$天翅$$ who was this one's master was imprisoned in the gap between dimensions by us.」

737:t_118:3.en:
$$シリウス$$
「And so the $$堕天翅$$ swore revenge on the $$御使い$$s...!」

737:t_118:4.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「That anger and hatred flowed from $$頭翅#pilot$$ into $$ミカゲ$$, didn't it!」

737:t_118:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then let's do it! The $$堕天翅$$, the humans... We'll hit them with the bitter regret of everyone these guys made suffer!」

737:t_118:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「There's no way you can, not a winged dog like you!」

737:t_118:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'm not the winged dog $$ポロン$$! I've got a name, $$アポロ$$, that a precious friend gave me!」

737:t_118:8.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Let's go, $$御使い$$s! For the sake of all life, we take you down right here!!」

737:t_119:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Strong...! They're on a whole different level from the enemies we've fought so far!」

737:t_119:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Well, obviously! There are two $$御使い$$s riding in this $$プロディキウム$$!」

737:t_119:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Do not get carried away just because you defeated $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! That one degenerated over the course of 12,000 years!」

737:t_119:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「If you have the strength of two, then I'll fight with the strength of every last $$エレメント$$ combined!」

737:t_119:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「And the love between $$ミコノ$$ and me won't lose to your 120 million years, either!」

737:t_119:6.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「A mere human has no right to speak of eternity!」

737:t_119:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Shut up! Whatever you say, the love between $$ミコノ$$ and me will surpass eternity!!」

737:t_120:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You... want to destroy the world again?」

737:t_120:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Reflect on your own deeds. This time you will destroy not just a single world, but the entire universe.」

737:t_120:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「If you understand, lay down your arms. And bow your head.」

737:t_120:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I can't... listen to words like that...!」

737:t_120:7.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't know... what's right and what's wrong... But I do know this...」

737:t_120:8.en:
$$シンジ$$
「You are the enemy of everything that lives! That's why I'm going to... fight!」

737:t_121:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「These guys aren't just ordinary villains!」

737:t_121:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Looks like you understand a little about how things work.」

737:t_121:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「But the way you condemn anyone who opposes you as evil, without a moment's thought, can only be called foolish.」

737:t_121:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That attitude of yours, looking down on us completely, makes me way angrier than any of the others ever did!」

737:t_121:4.en:
$$パーラ$$
「$$ガロード$$'s right! You're the most rotten scum we've ever met!」

737:t_121:5.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「How foolish. Wretches who, heedless of their own conduct, do nothing but hurl childish emotions at us.」

737:t_121:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What the hell are you saying!? You just decide anyone who won't obey you is evil! What part of that is smart!?」

737:t_121:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「We're going to live! No matter what you say, $$ティファ$$ and I have decided to move on into the future!!」

737:t_122:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Why didn't you use that power for the universe!? When those with power rule others with it, nothing is ever born! Why can't you understand that!?」

737:t_122:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「What's that supposed to mean!? Like what $$テンプティ$$ and the others did was wrong!」

737:t_122:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Leave it, $$テンプティ$$. In the end, it is pointless to preach our ideals to lowly creatures such as these.」

737:t_122:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「It's true, humanity is immature compared to you...」

737:t_122:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But we have a future ahead of us! And you're trying to take that future away!」

737:t_122:5.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Silence! That is our mission!」

737:t_122:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I won't... accept that! I'll fight people who say things like that!!」

737:t_123:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So these are the ones who block humanity's future...! The enemy we truly have to fight!」

737:t_123:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Too bad, $$ニュータイプ$$! You went to all the trouble of awakening, but you fail!」

737:t_123:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We will bury you before you proceed down the path of warped evolution! That is the duty of the universe's administrators!」

737:t_123:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I won't let you do whatever you want with my... with our lives and our future!」

737:t_123:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If I am a forerunner of humanity, then my duty is to cut a path to the future!」

737:t_123:5.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You struggle! With that immature power of yours!」

737:t_123:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That is a $$ニュータイプ$$'s mission...! It's my power, guided by the Gundam!!」

737:t_124:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「He's got good potential, this kid, doesn't he?」

737:t_124:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「A pity. Had he been raised under our management, he might have walked the path to $$シンカ$$.」

737:t_124:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't talk about people like they're pets! My life is mine!」

737:t_124:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We are $$御使い$$s. Beings who guide all life in the universe in the right direction.」

737:t_124:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That arrogance... I can't forgive it!」

737:t_124:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You take away the life that should fill the universe! You're beings who must not exist!!」

737:t_124:8.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'll strike down that arrogance! This is our final battle!!」

737:t_125:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Impressive, you. So it was the Gundam's power that awakened you.」

737:t_125:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Truly the very sin the civilization of fire has produced.」

737:t_125:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you talking about how the $$ユニコーン$$ drew out my power...!?」

737:t_125:3.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「But in the end, you didn't choose to cast off your body. That's the limit of humans.」

737:t_125:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Had you transcended matter back then, you could even have stepped into $$シンカ$$, and yet...」

737:t_125:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I don't regret my choice! There's still something I have to do with this body!」

737:t_125:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「To keep my promise to $$オードリー$$! And to do that, I'll defeat you and go home to Earth!」

737:t_125:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll show my own possibilities! With that power I'll open up the future!!」

737:t_126:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「To protect this universe, to open up the future...! I'll strike you down here!」

737:t_126:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「How stupid! In $$テンプティ$$'s eyes, your power is hardly any different from an ordinary human's!」

737:t_126:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You overestimated your own power! That is your sin!」

737:t_126:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「I don't think the $$イノベイター$$'s power alone can beat you...!」

737:t_126:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Then what else do you have, you!?」

737:t_126:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm a $$ガンダムマイスター$$ of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$... of $c!」

737:t_126:6.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm not alone! With the strength of all of us, I'll defeat you and open up a future for the universe!!」

737:t_127:0.en:
$$シン$$
「I understand everything now! Beings like you are what give rise to war in this universe!」

737:t_127:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Could it be you're angry that $$クロノ$$ persecuted the people of space?」

737:t_127:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「That was necessary to manage evolution. Though a mere individual like you would not understand.」

737:t_127:3.en:
$$シン$$
「I will never forgive the war that took the lives of those small human beings!」
